name: How much does it cost to paint interior trim?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to paint interior trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interior trim painting costs depend on the linear footage, trim condition, and whether prep work like caulking, patching, or sanding is required. Painting existing, smooth baseboards in good condition costs significantly less than restoring chipped, dented, or unprimed trim. Costs also shift depending on whether you are painting baseboards, window casings, door frames, or intricate crown molding. Because HH Remodeling handles both finish carpentry and painting in-house, owner Abraham Becerra evaluates whether damaged trim simply needs wood filler and paint or if replacing sections makes more financial sense before providing an estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Trim painting costs depend on total linear footage, trim type, and prep work like patching or caulking. Pricing is determined after an on-site review of the wood's condition.
